{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to completed orders only
completed = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Parse revenue and filter out QA orders
completed['revenue_numeric'] = completed['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
qa_orders = completed[completed['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99]

# Remove QA orders from analysis
analysis_data = completed[~completed.index.isin(qa_orders.index)]

# Verify final population
print("Final analysis population size:", len(analysis_data))
print("QA orders removed:", len(qa_orders))

# Check channel distribution
print("Channel distribution:", analysis_data['channel'].value_counts().to_dict())

# Check customer_segment distribution by channel
print("Customer segment by channel:")
print(analysis_data.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment']).size().unstack(fill_value=0))"}
